page.intro: Configure the email service and manage each user's notification preferences.
settings.fromEmail.help: Must be on your verified Resend sending domain.
settings.publicUrl.help: Used to build poster images and deep links in emails. Leave blank to attach posters instead.
settings.secretSet: A value is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
pref.intro: Each user chooses what they receive from their own settings. You can override it here. A user with no contact address is skipped at send time.
common.saveError: Could not save. Check the values and try again.
status.title: Transport status
status.quota: Sent: {m30} / {mLimit} in the last 30 days, {d} / {dLimit} today.
status.warn: You have used 80 percent of a sending limit.
status.fileTransformationMissing: FileTransformation plugin: missing. The user settings panel will not be injected.
manual.intro: Write a one-off email. It is sent to every user with a contact address (or a chosen subset), regardless of their category preferences.
manual.subject: Subject
manual.error.subject: A subject is required.
manual.error.send: Could not send. Check the transport settings and try again.
logs.intro: The plugin's own dedicated log file. Refresh to load the latest lines.
logs.level.label: Level
campaigns.intro: The two scheduled campaigns. Enable one, set its recurrence and mail language, or run it now. Recipients are the users opted in to the matching category.
campaigns.error.noContactEmail: Set your contact address in your notification preferences first.
campaigns.error.dayOfWeek: Choose a day of the week.
campaigns.error.dayOfMonth: Enter a day of month between 1 and 31.
campaigns.error.intervalDays: Enter an interval of at least 1 day.
templates.intro: The base templates are read-only. Clone one to make an editable copy, then point a campaign at it from the Campaigns tab.
templates.clone.prompt: Name for the new template (letters, digits and hyphens):
templates.base.readonly: This is a base template and cannot be edited. Clone it to make changes.
templates.error.script: A script tag is not allowed in a template.
templates.error.tooLarge: This template is too large (max 64 KB).
templates.error.clone: Could not clone. Check the name and try again.
templates.error.inUse: This template is still used by the campaign {campaign}. Point that campaign at another template first.
